title: persea curranii
intro: Persea curranii, commonly known as Palosanto or White Sandalo, is a tropical evergreen tree species native to the Philippines and other parts of Southeast Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate respiratory issues, wounds, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Persea curranii include its ability to act as an expectorant, anti-inflammatory agent, and antioxidant, supporting the immune system and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Persea curranii include sesquiterpenes, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in traditional medicine and modern pharmacology.
